items.heading: Many Students Say They Have
items.text: Many Students Say They Have Many Students Say They Have Many students say they have no interests. In most cases they have not tried enough things, or they have tried them without a clear task. Interest often follows skill and small wins, so waiting for it to appear is the slow route.

items.heading: A Skill with Direct Clients
items.text: A skill with direct clients lets you earn early and learn what you like by doing paid work. See freelance skills in demand .
